desc:
Choose Your Anime Ball. Watch It Battle!

⚔️ Battle other players in 1v1 
🎲 Choose 1 of 3 random Anime Balls each round!
🌟 Collect your favorite anime characters and unleash powerful abilities!
💥 Every Anime Ball has its own unique skills and powers!
🏆 Win battles, climb the leaderboard, and become the strongest!

👥 Join the group for a FREE reward!

⭐ Like the game and follow for more updates!
